About Me

A graphic designer working at the sharp end of live sport — translating a client's voice into visual work that millions see in the moment.

I specialise in broadcast design, brand identity, and visual communication across a range of projects. Most of my days are spent building live graphics for sport television — fast, high-pressure, unforgiving work that I genuinely love. I'm involved from the first concept sketch through to delivery on air.

I'm proficient across a wide set of design programs and I'm not a one-note designer: I'm just as invested in brand work as I am in motion, getting under the skin of what a company stands for and shaping that into something people feel. Above all I thrive on the challenge of learning, and I'm always looking for the next opportunity to grow.
